tools.name: alphayou_search_datasets
tools.description: What data AlphaYou has and which tool returns it, with each tool's plan and cost. Costs no requests. Call this first to decide what to call next. Optional q filters the list by a word.

tools.name: alphayou_funds
tools.description: The institutional investment managers whose Form 13F filings AlphaYou tracks: latest reporting period, filing date, position count, the total value the filer reported and the SEC filing link. Raw filing data, biggest reported value first, the same for every user. Pages with nextCursor.

tools.name: alphayou_company_disclosures
tools.description: Recent SEC 8-K filings for one US-listed company, read from SEC EDGAR: the items filed (with their titles), the filing date and the original SEC link. tools.name: alphayou_insider_trades
tools.description: Insider open-market buys and sells from SEC Form 4 filings, newest first: the insider, their role, each trade with date, shares and price, the 10b5-1 plan label and the SEC link. tools.name: alphayou_insider_clusters
tools.description: Companies where several different insiders filed an open-market buy (or sale) on SEC Form 4 inside a short window: how many insiders, how many filings, how many under a 10b5-1 plan, and who. A plain count with its parameters shown (side, days up to 90, minimum insiders), not a score or a prediction.
